question: Explain the auditor's responsibilities under SA 560 for events occurring between the date of the financial statements and the date of the auditor's report, and for facts discovered after the report is issued.

points.label: Types of subsequent events
points.description: Events between the date of the financial statements and the date of the auditor's report, and facts discovered after the date of the report; adjusting events and non-adjusting events.
points.basis: SA 560, definitions of subsequent events and the events covered by the standard

points.label: Procedures up to the date of the report
points.description: Perform procedures to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence that all events up to the date of the auditor's report requiring adjustment or disclosure have been identified: review management procedures, minutes, latest interim statements, and inquire.
points.basis: SA 560, events occurring between the date of the financial statements and the date of the auditor's report

points.label: Written representations on subsequent events
points.description: Request written representations that all events after the date of the financial statements requiring adjustment or disclosure have been adjusted or disclosed.
points.basis: SA 560 read with SA 580, written representations on subsequent events

points.label: Facts discovered after the date of the report but before issue
points.description: Discuss the matter with management and those charged with governance; if the financial statements are amended, extend procedures and give a new report dated no earlier than the approval of the amended statements.
points.basis: SA 560, facts which become known to the auditor after the date of the auditor's report but before the financial statements are issued

points.label: Facts discovered after the financial statements are issued
points.description: Consider whether the financial statements need amendment, discuss with management, and if management does not act, take action to prevent reliance on the auditor's report.
points.basis: SA 560, facts which become known to the auditor after the financial statements have been issued
